Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

Wall-mounted towel storage features a spacious 60cm rail, ideal for larger towels. Designed for easy cleaning and long-term hygiene. Made from durable stainless steel for resistance to moisture, rust, and mould. Can be installed using screws to support up to 5kg, or 3M adhesive to hold up to 2kg. Chrome.
